label: Give a slow boot up to 60 s before other probes
code:
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: http
  periodSeconds: 2
  failureThreshold: 30

label: Send traffic only while the api can serve it
code:
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /ready
    port: http
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 2

label: Restart only a process that stopped answering
code:
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: http
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 2
  failureThreshold: 3

label: Restart only a process that stopped answering
code:
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /ready
    port: http
  periodSeconds: 10
  timeoutSeconds: 2
  failureThreshold: 3

label: Send traffic only while the api can serve it
code:
readinessProbe:
  tcpSocket:
    port: http
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 2

label: Give a slow boot up to 60 s before other probes
code:
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: http
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
